terms.definition: A Wikidata item with at least one Wikipedia sitelink: the unit of a topic.
A link from a Wikidata item to the article about it in one Wikipedia.
Time from an item's first article in the reference set to its article in language L (redirects, deleted and bot-created pages excluded).
Time from the start of an edit burst in the first language to a burst in language L (milestone 3).
A window whose human edit count is far above the page's own baseline (robust threshold, parameters published in docs/method.md; milestone 3).
Readers looking for a topic in a language that has no article on it, measured by a published proxy (milestone 3).
Article size and revision count relative to the first language.
The languages whose earliest article defines an item's start; the 20-language slice in milestone 2, all Wikipedias from milestone 3.
A live event older than its batch's per-stream watermark minus 600 seconds.
